mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in new housing starts (HOUST) and a slowdown in job growth (PAYEMS) signals a broad-based economic contraction, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS decline.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a CPIAUCSL above 2.5% annually signals persistent inflation that forces the Fed to continue tightening, which pressures equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with high inflation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,000 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand for housing, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery (UNRATE declining), a strong job growth (PAYEMS MoM change > 100) signals robust economic expansion, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declining (MoM) and PAYEMS MoM change > 100
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS MoM change > 100.
